name: Two (formerly Tillit)
what: B2B buy-now-pay-later and payments checkout for merchants selling to businesses (Oslo).
homonym_note: Same company as the sequoia-capital row 'Two' (Sequoia backed Tillit's 2021 round and Two lists Sequoia among its investors), but that row's status 'acquired' and HQ country US are not supported: Two raised EUR 13M in July 2025 and announced a DNB partnership in March 2026.

membership.basis: Live visionaries.vc portfolio (thesis names founder Andreas Mjelde); TechCrunch 2021 and tech.eu 2023 name Visionaries Club; Two's own about page lists Visionaries Club.
membership.quote: alongside seed investors LocalGlobe and Visionaries Club

entry.quote: alongside seed investors LocalGlobe and Visionaries Club

graduation.quote: This round was led by Shine Capital and Antler

notes: TechCrunch does not name the EUR 2.5M round; the round is called seed here because TechCrunch calls LocalGlobe and Visionaries 'seed investors' and the company had not launched (Nordic9 headline: 'Tillit to raise EUR 2.5 million in a round led by Sequoia and including LocalGlobe and Visionaries Club'). The phrase 'alongside seed investors' could also mean Visionaries was already in from an earlier seed; no earlier Visionaries round was found, hence medium confidence. tech.eu 2023: EUR 10M raised before the Series A, so an unreported seed extension may exist. Two's about page lists Visionaries Club under 'Founder & Angel Networks', not under VCs; the firm's own portfolio listing and the 2021/2023 press treat it as the fund. Visionaries is not named in the 2025 EUR 13M round list.
